<issue>
Content types element generation broken after recent changes

#### Description

The `_ContentTypesItem._element` property is not generating valid XML content. When trying to create content types elements, the method appears to have issues with the order of operations and variable initialization.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from docx.opc.pkgwriter import _ContentTypesItem

# Create a content types item and try to get its element
cti = _ContentTypesItem()
cti.add_default('xml', 'application/xml')
cti.add_override('/word/document.xml', 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document.main+xml')

# This should work but fails
element = cti._element
print(element.xml)
```

Also affects package writing functionality:

```python
from docx.opc.pkgwriter import PackageWriter
from unittest.mock import Mock

pkg_file = Mock()
pkg_rels = Mock() 
parts = Mock()

# This fails during the write process
PackageWriter.write(pkg_file, pkg_rels, parts)
```

The issue seems to be related to how the content types XML element is being constructed and the order in which different components are written to the package.
</issue>
